description: This file defines functions and types related to resolving and managing CLI backend configurations for the OpenClaw project, including normalization, merging, and retrieval of backend IDs and configs.

methods.name: resolveFallbackBundleMcpCapability
methods.description: Determines if the provider supports fallback MCP capability, specifically for 'claude-cli'.

methods.name: normalizeBackendKey
methods.description: Normalizes a backend key using the imported 'normalizeProviderId' function.

methods.name: pickBackendConfig
methods.description: Selects a backend configuration matching the normalized ID from a set of configs.

methods.name: resolveRegisteredBackend
methods.description: Finds a registered backend matching the normalized provider ID.

methods.name: mergeBackendConfig
methods.description: Merges two backend configurations, with override taking precedence.

methods.name: resolveCliBackendIds
methods.description: Returns a set of all CLI backend IDs, including runtime and configured ones.

methods.name: resolveCliBackendConfig
methods.description: Resolves the full configuration for a given provider, considering registered, configured, and fallback options.
